source.text: In the dose escalation, patients must have a histologically documented locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic solid tumor
In the dose expansion, patients must have histologically documented locally advanced, unresectable or metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancer

HER2 expression by immunohistochemistry (IHC) (1+, 2+, or 3+) or HER2 amplification by in situ hybridization (ISH) or next generation sequencing (NGS) (on any Clinical Laboratory Improvements Amendments \[CLIA\] platform on tissue), AND
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of ≤ 1 (Karnofsky ≥ 70%).
Human immunodeficiency virus-infected patients on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible for this trial
For patients with HCV infection who are currently on treatment, they are eligible if they have an undetectable HCV viral load

Patients with new or progressive brain metastases (active brain metastases) or leptomeningeal disease are eligible if the treating physician determines that immediate CNS-specific treatment is not required and is unlikely to be required during the first cycle of study treatment

Pregnant women are excluded from this study because T-DXd (DS-8201a) and azenosertib (ZN-c3) have the potential risk for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.
Patients with history of non-infectious pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease (ILD), current ILD, or where suspected ILD cannot be ruled out by imaging at screening

Patients with a medical history of myocardial infarction within 6 months before enrollment, symptomatic congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association class IIb to IV), and/or troponin levels consistent with myocardial infarction as defined according to the manufacturer 28 days prior to enrollment
Patients with prior allogeneic organ transplantation including allogeneic stem cell transplantation
